manager.name: Task Delegation Coordinator
manager.description: Orchestrates the delegation workflow by routing email data to parsing, coordinating task creation, and ensuring Slack notifications are sent with complete context

sub_agents.name: Email Parser Agent
sub_agents.description: Scans Gmail for emails containing delegation keywords (urgent, team, delegate), extracts task title, description, priority level, context, and identifies teammate mentions (@name, for name)

sub_agents.name: Task Structurer Agent
sub_agents.description: Structures extracted information into organized task format with clear title, description, priority classification, and assignee details

sub_agents.name: Slack Notifier Agent
sub_agents.description: Composes and sends personalized Slack messages to identified teammates with task title, description, priority, and context information
